items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

ctx.x: Now what made you want to play the trumpet as a young boy?

It’s a funny story. I always wanted to sing. And I used to go around singing and humming and going on you know [humms], so people called me “Little Satch.” And I didn’t know, and you may not believe this, but they gave us some used instruments from the other high school across town and I picked out the cornet and you wouldn’t believe that I started to play and the first note that I ever played, and the first thing I ever played was “When You’re Smiling” and when I found out that I was playing “When Your Smiling”…
